audiences.executive: Put AI to work on your own data at a cost you can predict, under your control, and turn pilots into services the business uses.
audiences.technical: Models, GPUs, data and agents run as a governed platform: endpoints per team, permissions on retrieval, limits on what agents may call and spend.
audiences.financial: Cost counted per finished piece of work, not per token; owned capacity for steady work, hosted models where they earn their price.

people: Whoever owns AI in the business: the programme sponsor
A business owner with a use case and its data
Infrastructure and operations, who will run the GPUs
Platform engineers and developers who will build on it

objections.says: We already use a hosted AI service: why run our own?
objections.clarify: What does one finished piece of work cost today, and which data cannot leave?
objections.answer: Keep hosted models where they earn their price; run steady or sensitive work on your own capacity, behind the same access point.
objections.prove: Run one use case on a hosted model and on a self-hosted one, and compare what each finished piece of work costs.

objections.says: We have no GPUs, and they are hard to get.
objections.clarify: Which use cases need GPUs now, and could any start on rented capacity?
objections.answer: Start where capacity exists, rented or owned, on the same platform, and move as hardware arrives.
objections.prove: Serve a model on the capacity available within the test window and record its throughput.

objections.says: Our AI projects never get past the pilot.
objections.clarify: What stopped the last one: data, security, cost or operations?
objections.answer: Make what production needs the test: access control, cost limits, monitoring and an owner.
objections.prove: Take one pilot to a governed endpoint, with access control, cost limits and monitoring, used by real users.

objections.says: Agents could do anything with our data.
objections.clarify: Which tools and data should an agent reach, and who approves new ones?
objections.answer: Give each agent a list of tools and data it may use, a spending limit, and a record of every call.
objections.prove: Block an agent from a tool it is not allowed to use and show the record of the attempt.
